scope: Parts 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 6A, 7, 8, 9, 10 and 12 - every operative Part of the Act except Part 1 (preliminary), Part 11 (repealed) and Parts 13 to 16 (inspection, general, and the final provisions). Within those Parts, not encoded: s 19, s 34, s 39, ss 41-41A, ss 47-53, s 66 (registration of contractors), ss 70-75, ss 84-87A (dismissal before confinement, contracting out, childcare leave), s 90, and ss 97-101. PART 9 IS THE CURRENT LAW ONLY: s 76 carries three qualifying rules side by side for confinements before 1 May 2013, between then and 22 August 2015, and after; only the last is encoded, so a confinement before 22 August 2015 is outside this encoding entirely. Everything the Act leaves to be prescribed - record retention periods, pay slip timing, the Fifth Schedule reckoning, the minimum period of service under s 95A - is a fact supplied, and the regulations were not retrieved.
